communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-927809341
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $0 on my statement from FreeTrial Corp. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-927809341
communications.body: I contacted FreeTrial Corp's customer support via their website chat on February 05, 2026. The representative, 'Maya,' confirmed that their system showed only one active free trial under my email. When I explained the duplicate $0.00 transaction on my bank statement, she was unable to explain why it appeared twice and advised me to contact my bank as it might be a 'bank-side processing issue' or a 'visual error' on my statement. She confirmed there was no financial impact from their end and couldn't process a cancellation for a $0.00 transaction.
